subject: Proposal: invoice breakout and cost-center tagging for ACME (multi-entity)
messages:
From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@acme-industries.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@acme-industries.com
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Multi-entity invoicing for Redwood usage (next invoice cycle)

Hi Jordan,

Quick one from our side as we get ready for the July invoice: ACME purchased Redwood for two legal entities (ACME Holdings, ACME Manufacturing) and we need to route costs back to different GL codes/cost centers. Two items we need your help on:

- Can Redwood emit a single invoice with line-level entity tags (VAT numbers + PO lines) so our AP team can auto-split on ingestion?
- If not, can you provide separate invoices per legal entity and attach consolidated summary?

Also, we have different VAT numbers and payment instructions for EU shipments vs US. Our billing team needs the VAT number at the invoice header level (not just per line). Attached is our internal breakout template to illustrate the cost-center mapping.

Can you confirm the options and any lead time to implement for the Aug invoice?

Thanks,
Amir Patel
Senior Procurement Manager
ACME Industries
finance@acme-industries.com
Attachment: breakout-template.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Amir Patel <amir.patel@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing for Redwood usage (next invoice cycle)

Hi Amir —

Thanks for the clear template. Short answer: we can support both approaches, but each has tradeoffs. Looping in Markus (finance ops) and Laura (legal/enterprise billing) to confirm constraints.

Two practical options we typically offer:

1) Split invoices: Redwood issues separate invoices per legal entity (each with its own header VAT/tax ID). Pros: clean tax treatment, easier for AP to remit to the right bank details. Cons: increases docs count and may break consolidated GL reporting if you expect one invoice.

2) Single invoice with line-level entity tags: We can include custom metadata (entity_id and cost_center) per invoice line and a CSV/JSON attachment that your AP system can ingest to auto-split. Note: VAT header will be the billing entity on the invoice header; we can surface VAT numbers per line in the attachment but many tax teams prefer header-level VAT.

Practical timeline: Markus — could you confirm if finance is able to produce multiple PDFs in our pipeline vs adding a structured attachment? Also advise on whether Redwood needs PO-level hints to map to cost centers.

Amir — I can run a sample export for July usage to show both formats by EOD tomorrow, and we can pick which you prefer for August.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: +1 (415) 555-0149
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Amir Patel <amir.patel@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing for Redwood usage (next invoice cycle)

Hi all,

Markus from Finance Ops here — thanks for flagging. Quick notes from our side:

- We can generate separate invoices per legal entity. Implementation: we need a mapping file (entity_id -> account_id) and explicit PO/PO line references for reconciliation. Lead time: 7 business days to add a new template to the billing pipeline; faster (2-3 days) if we're re-using the existing multi-invoice flow we built for a different customer.

- For single-invoice + attachment: we can include a machine-readable CSV that lists: line_number, sku/usage_bucket, entity_id, cost_center, VAT_number (if supplied), and payment_instruction_id. That CSV will be attached to the invoice PDF as billing_metadata.csv. Your AP system can parse and auto-route.

- VAT: tax law requires the VAT-registered legal entity to appear on the invoice header for EU intra-community B2B. We can put VAT numbers in the CSV, but they won't substitute for header-level VAT in certain jurisdictions. If you need header VAT for two separate legal entities in the same invoice, we'd have to produce separate invoice documents.

- Payments: we can support split wire instructions by entity (separate bank details). For credit card auto-pay we can split charges but system limitations mean you'll see a single settlement record unless we route charges to separate merchant accounts (enterprise-only; extra setup).

Attachments: I’ve uploaded a sample export to Drive and attached a mock invoice (SOW-Redwood-ACME-2026.pdf) that shows the two formats.

Action items before we push to production:
- Amir: confirm preferred approach (separate invoices vs single-with-CSV)
- Amir: provide entity registry (legal name, tax id, bank instructions) in the template
- Jordan/Amir: confirm whether AP requires PO-level mapping or cost center tags are sufficient

If you want, we can run a one-off test invoice in staging for August and route it to your finance mailbox for validation.

Cheers,
Markus Klein
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: SOW-Redwood-ACME-2026.pdf (mock invoice stub)
From: Amir Patel <amir.patel@acme-industries.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: finance@acme-industries.com
Date: Tue, 21 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Multi-entity invoicing for Redwood usage (next invoice cycle)

Hi Markus — thanks, that is helpful. We prefer separate invoices per legal entity so our VAT handling stays clean. A couple of clarifications:

- For ACME Manufacturing (EU operations) we require the EU VAT number on the invoice header.
- For ACME Holdings (US) use the US tax ID on its invoice.
- Can the PDFs include a consolidated cover sheet listing total spend across entities and per cost center? That would help our central finance team.
- Lead time: 7 days is fine. Can you schedule the first split invoice for Aug 1 (billing period July 1–31)?

I’ll attach the completed entity registry and our AP routing file by EOD.

Thanks —
Amir
